messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give it a quick wash, polish the finish, and tune it properly. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and shows buyers you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Capture the body, neck, headstock, strings, and any visible wear or damage from multiple angles. | Good photos attract more views and reduce back‑and‑forth questions. | | **3. Write a Detailed Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, wood type, pickup type (if any), condition notes, and why you’re selling. | Transparency builds trust and reduces negotiations later. | | **4. Research Pricing** | Check recent sales on eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, and local listings for similar models. | Helps set a realistic asking price and speeds up the sale. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Online Marketplaces** – eBay, Reverb, Etsy, Amazon
• **Local Classifieds** – Craigslist, Gumtree, Kijiji
• **Social Media** – Facebook Marketplace, Instagram, Reddit r/forSale, local buy/sell groups
• **Music‑Specific Sites** – Gear4music, Musician’s Friend, local instrument shops’ resale sections | Different platforms reach different audiences; use a mix for maximum exposure. | | **6. List Your Guitar** | Upload photos, paste description, set price, choose shipping options (if selling online). | A clear, complete listing reduces time on market. | | **7. Promote** | Share the link in relevant groups, tag friends who might know someone looking, post a story or reel showing the guitar. | Extra visibility often leads to quicker offers. | | **8. Negotiate Safely** | Use platform messaging whenever possible. If meeting in person, choose a public place (coffee shop, library) and bring a friend if you’re nervous. | Protects both parties and keeps records of communication. | | **9. Handle Payment & Shipping** | For online sales, accept PayPal Goods & Services, Venmo, or bank transfer. Ship via USPS Priority Mail or UPS Ground with insurance and tracking. | Ensures you receive payment and protects against loss/damage. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | Once payment clears, ship immediately. Keep receipts and tracking numbers. | Keeps everything documented and gives buyer peace of mind. | ### Quick Tips * **Bundle Extras** – Offer a strap, case, or extra strings as a bonus; it can justify a slightly higher price. * **Mention Upgrades** – If you’ve upgraded pickups, hardware, or added a new finish, highlight those improvements. * **Be Honest About Wear** – Disclose scratches, fret wear, or any repairs. Honesty prevents disputes after the sale. * **Use “For Sale” Tags** – On social media, add #forsale, #guitar, #acoustic, and location tags to increase discoverability. ### Example Listing Template ``` Title: 2010 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand/Model: Yamaha FG800 - Year: 2010 - Wood: Spruce top, mahogany back & sides - Serial #: 12345678 - Condition: Light play marks, no cracks, fully functional - Extras: New set of strings, strap, and a protective case - Reason for selling: Moving to a smaller apartment Price: $350 (negotiable) Photos attached: front, back, headstock, neck, strings, and close‑up of the soundhole. Contact: DM me or email example@example.com. Local pickup available in [City] or shipping within the US. ``` Feel free to adapt this template to fit your guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice on selling an acoustic guitar. We need to provide guidance: listing online marketplaces (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace), local music stores, classifieds, social media groups, etc. Also mention preparing the guitar, taking photos, setting price, describing condition, shipping options, safety tips. Possibly mention using the tune_instrument function? But that's about tuning. Not relevant. So we just give textual answer.

We don't need to call any tool. Just respond with advice.
